question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**low lying**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
• **middle: **the point or position at an equal distance from the sides, edges, or ends of something.
 
• **high rise: **(of a building) having many storeys.
 
• **low lying: **at low altitude above sea level.
 
• **uplifted: **placed in a higher position; raised.
 
• According to the given context and meaning, low lying is the appropriate option here
 
 
• **Example**: *The **low-lying**__ buildings near the river were destroyed during the flood.*
 
 

**The complete passage is:* ****Delhi recorded a spell of light rain **(1) on** Friday evening with humidity levels remaining on the higher side throughout** (2)** **the **day. The IMD has forecast moderate rain on Saturday but some areas **(3) are expected** to get heavy rain. An official also said that the next seven days are **(4)** **likely **to see good rain. The municipal corporation has been advised to remain prepared for water logging in **(5) low-lying** areas of the city.*
